title: Culture of mouse prostate organoids
protocol: Combine 200 μL of 10x collagenase/hyaluronase mixture with 1.8 mL DMEM/F12 + 5% FBS.
Place the mixture in a 37°C water bath until ready to use.
Resect mouse prostates and transfer them to a sterile petri dish containing cold PBS for dissection.
Using fine forceps and sharp scissors, remove residual fat from the prostate tissue under a dissecting microscope.
Fill a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube with 1 mL of pre-warmed diluted collagenase/hyaluronidase solution.
Transfer the prostate tissue into the Eppendorf tube containing the solution.
Using small, sharp sterile scissors, macerate the prostate tissue by cutting it rapidly into small pieces inside the tube.
Fill the tube with an additional 400-500 μL of dilute collagenase/hyaluronidase solution until almost full.
Incubate in a 37°C incubator for 3 hours.
Centrifuge digested tissue at 350 rcf for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1.5 mL of cold 0.25% trypsin-EDTA.
Transfer to a 50 mL conical tube.
Incubate in a 4°C refrigerator for 1 hour.
Place 900 µL of dispase in a 37°C water bath at least 10 minutes prior to use.
Add 100 µL of DNaseI to the dispase solution immediately before use.
After trypsinization is complete (1 hour), add cold HBSS + 2% FBS equal to 2x volume of trypsin to quench the reaction.
Centrifuge at 350 rcf for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of pre-warmed dispase/DNaseI solution.
Pipette the sample vigorously for 1-2 minutes until homogenously translucent with no visible tissue fragments.
Add cold HBSS + 2% FBS equal to 5x volume of dispase to quench reaction.
Filter cell suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge filtered suspension at 350 rcf for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL HBSS + 2% FBS and transfer to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Count viable cells using a hemacytometer and trypan blue.
Centrifuge and resuspend cells in HBSS + 2% FBS at 100 µL/1 x 10^6 cells.
If fewer than 1 x 10^6 cells are obtained, resuspend in 100 µL.
Divide cell suspension into four 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes as follows:
Tube 1 (unstained control): 100 µL (1x10^6 cells).
Tube 2 (PerCP control): 100 µL (1x10^6 cells).
Tube 3 (APC control): 100 µL (1x10^6 cells).
Tube 4 (sample for collection): remaining sample (up to 1 mL).
Add FACS antibodies as follows:
Tube 1: no antibody.
Cover tubes with foil and incubate on ice for 25 minutes.
Spin tubes at 350 rcf at 4°C for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Add 500 μl cold HBSS + 2% FBS to all tubes.
Spin tubes at 350 rcf at 4°C for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Resuspend all tubes in 500 μl cold HBSS + 2% FBS + 10 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632.
Prepare a 1:100 dilution of 0.5 mg/ml DAPI by adding 5 μl DAPI to 495 μl HBSS + 2% FBS.
Add 10 μl of diluted DAPI to each tube.
Transfer each suspension into labeled round-bottom clear rubber-top plastic test tubes for loading into sorter.
Prior to sorting, prepare multiple 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes pre-filled with 500 μl cold HBSS + 2% FBS + 10 μM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 for collecting cells.
Perform sorting via sterile FACS facility.
Use tubes 1-3 to set appropriate gates.
Collect cells at 60,000 cells per tube.
Keep collected cells on ice until ready to plate.
Prepare desired amount of culture medium by combining the following components:
Mix hepatocyte medium at a final volume of 47 mL per 50 mL media.
Add 10 ng/mL EGF (use 100 µL of 5 µg/mL stock per 50 mL media).
Add 5% heat-inactivated, charcoal-stripped FBS (2.5 mL per 50 mL media).
Mix 1x Glutamax at a final volume of 500 µL per 50 mL media.
Add 5% Matrigel at a final volume of 50 µL per 1 mL media on the day of use.
Add 10 µM ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 (use 2 µL of 5 mM stock per 1 mL media) on the day of use.
Add 100 nM DHT (use 10 µL of 10^-5 M stock per 1 mL media) on the day of use.
Optionally, add 1x antibiotic-antimycotic at a final volume of 10 µL per 1 mL media.
Keep prepared culture media at room temperature until use.
Centrifuge sorted cells at 350 rcf for 5 minutes.
Resuspend centrifuged cells in prepared media at a density of 5,000 cells per 100 μL.
Add resuspended cells to each well of a 96-well low attachment plate using 100 μL per well.
Change the media every 4 days by adding 100 μL fresh media on days 4 and 8 after plating.
On day 12, when wells are full (300 μL), transfer each well to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the transferred cells at 250 rcf for 5 minutes.
Remove 200 μL of supernatant and add 100 μL fresh media, making the total volume 200 μL.
Transfer the cells onto a new 96-well plate using a P1000 pipet tip.
Alternate every 4 days between adding 100 μL media or spinning down to remove 200 μL and add 100 μL until ready for passage.
Prepare cold media as specified in section 2.4.1, excluding component e and adjusting component f to a final concentration of 25 µM.
Pellet cells as described in section 2.4.3 and resuspend them in the prepared cold media at a density of 5,000 cells per 40 µL of media.
If cells were collected at 60,000 cells per Eppendorf tube, resuspend these cells in 480 µL of media.
Mix the 40 µL media containing cells thoroughly with 60 µL Matrigel. If using 60,000 cells suspended in 480 µL media, mix with 720 µL Matrigel to avoid forming bubbles.
Perform this mixing step on ice to prevent solidification of the Matrigel.
Plate a 100 µL mixture of media and Matrigel around the ring of a well in a 24-well plate.
Incubate the 24-well plate in a 37°C incubator for 30 minutes to allow the Matrigel ring to solidify.
Add 400 µL of pre-warmed media prepared according to section 2.5.1 to each well, ensuring that the media is warm enough to avoid dissolving the Matrigel ring.
Change the media every 4 days by aspirating off the existing media from the middle of the well and adding fresh media without disturbing the Matrigel ring.
Prepare organoids for passage when they are large, usually 3-5 weeks after plating.
Transfer organoids into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and spin at 250 rcf for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells in cold PBS and spin again at 250 rcf for 5 minutes.
Add 1 mL warm 0.25% trypsin/EDTA and incubate in a 37°C water bath for 5 minutes.
Pipette up and down with P200 pipet tip for 30 seconds to dissociate cells.
Transfer suspension into a 15 mL conical tube prefilled with 2 mL cold HBSS + 2% FBS.
Centrifuge at 350 rcf for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in fresh media.
Plate resuspended cells into a new low-attachment 96-well plate.
Centrifuge organoids at 250 rcf for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 1 mL freezing media in 1.8 mL cryo tubes (50% FBS, 40% hepatocyte media, 10% DMSO).
Gradually freeze to ≤ -80°C using an insulated cryofreezing container.
Thaw organoids rapidly in a 37°C water bath.
Dilute thawed organoids in 10 mL HBSS + 2% FBS per 1 mL freezing media.
Centrifuge thawed organoids at 250 rcf for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in organoid culture media for plating.
Add about 125 µL dispase at 5 mg/mL to each well of the 24-well plate to make a final concentration of dispase 1 mg/ml.
Incubate in 37°C incubator for 10 minutes.
If Matrigel ring dissolves, proceed as per standard protocol.
If not, continue incubation at 37°C for another 5 minutes.
